description:
Terminal has 5 tests covering the happy path. Gaps:

- `terminate/2` with non-`:normal` reason — does raw_mode_fn
  still get called with `:exit` on crash? Currently only the
  `:normal` case is verified.
- `write/2` routes bytes to the injected write_fn; no test
  verifies the production path (IO.write default).
- The stdin reader loop silently exits on `:io.get_chars`
  returning `:eof`. The Terminal keeps running, no keystrokes
  arrive, user sees a frozen TUI. Add:
  - A warning log on reader exit (`:eof`, `{:error, _}`).
  - An optional telemetry event
    `[:octo_pi_tui, :terminal, :reader_exit]` so consumers
    can detect it.

TDD:
- GenServer.stop(terminal, :shutdown) → raw_mode_fn called
  with :exit.
- Simulate :io.get_chars/2 returning :eof via an injected
  reader fn; assert log + telemetry.
- write/2 default path: capture via ExUnit.CaptureIO, assert
  IO.write was used.
title: Terminal test coverage + reader :eof diagnostics
